liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Whinin' Boy Blues** (1 review): Whinin' Boy Blues is described as shiny and golden in this performance [12]
- **This Time Forever** (1 review): Hearing Jerry perform This Time Forever is described as sweet [13]
- **Big Boy Pete** (1 review): Big Boy Pete and Jack A Roe are highlighted as really cool [15]
- **Deep Elem Blues** (1 review): The Deep Elem Blues performance is described as heartbreaking [16]

## The recordings

- **gd78-11-17.paud.wiley.11488.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 12 songs; 91 min; rated 3.09/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd78-11-17.acoustic.sbd.dodd.7687.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 44 min; rated 4.58/5 by 33 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording has decent sound quality and captures the musicians having fun; Good sound quality allows clear hearing of the slightly pushy crowd; Very nice sound quality noted for this little show [11][12][14][15]
- **gd1978-11-17.sbd.dodd.audiohead22.remaster-7687.90110.sbefail.flac16**: soundboard; 10 songs; 45 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [4]
- **gd1978-11-17.157672.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 10 songs; 44 min [5]. Said about its sound: Right channel copied over left due to better condition, making it mono; Substantial level adjustments and background noise reduction were applied [5]

## Around the show

- Small venue and crowd enjoyed the acoustic charity set with good interplay [8]
- Bob Weir led with Garcia and Mickey Hart joining for most of the set [11]
- Bar room parlor-band style present during the chill Big Boy Pete [13]
- Classic stage banter includes Jerry Garcia saying he is new around here [14]
- Bobby's slide playing is better when he cannot reach the 17th fret [19]
- Mickey Hart joined the acoustic group from Deep Elem Blues through the end [5]
- Show gives a taste of later acoustic sets in New Orleans and Warfield [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-11-17.paud.wiley.11488.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Audio path is AUD to MC to DAT to CDR, seeded by T. Wiley [1]
- **gd78-11-17.acoustic.sbd.dodd.7687.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Soundboard source transferred via Ernie Dodd to SHN format [3]
- **gd1978-11-17.sbd.dodd.audiohead22.remaster-7687.90110.sbefail.flac16**: transferred by audiohead22; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Audiohead22 edited hiss, FFT, and repaired reel glitches in 2008 [4]
- **gd1978-11-17.157672.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by unknown; transferred by Matt Vernon, SirMick; source: unknown audience recording (unk gens) - from the collection of Doug Lamarre [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1978-11-17 Rambler Room, Loyola University, Chicago IL - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-11-17-rambler-room-loyola-university-chicago-il/) [21]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [Rambler Room, Loyola College, Chicago, IL - 11/17/1978 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/rambler-room-loyola-college-chicago-il-11-17-1978-17/) [22]
